name: Mourning Lantern
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The lantern can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the lantern has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Wick-Touch
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 24 (6d6 + 3) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Wick-Siphon
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: The lantern dips low and its flame siphons the warmth from a living creature, leaving the target's extremities cold and

lore: Born of a burial lantern lit for someone who was never found, the Mourning Lantern drifts the night roads siphoning the warmth of the living into a wick that will not stay lit.

generation.cite: composition after Specter (CR 1) — the drain touch on the incorporeal frame
generation.gap_death_sites: 1x the call named no template for the pick

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
